title: Where to Buy a Laptop in Sharjah: A Local Buyer's Guide
content:
Sharjah is one of the best places in the UAE to buy a laptop on a budget. The industrial areas are home to many computer traders, and prices for used and renewed business laptops are often lower than in Dubai malls. The choice can also be overwhelming. This guide explains how to buy a laptop in Sharjah without getting a bad unit, and what you should expect to pay.

Your options in Sharjah

What to check before you pay

  1. Ask for a battery report. On Windows, the shop can run powercfg /batteryreport; on a Mac, check the cycle count in System Information.
  2. Look at the screen on white and black backgrounds for dead pixels, marks and uneven backlight.
  3. Test every port: USB, USB-C, HDMI, headphone jack and the charger port.
  4. Type a full sentence and use the trackpad, including right-click and scrolling.
  5. Check the processor generation. For Windows 11, choose Intel 8th Gen or newer.
  6. Confirm the Windows licence is activated and that no previous owner's account or company management is left on it.
  7. Get the warranty and return terms in writing, together with an invoice.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I buy a used laptop in Sharjah?

Sharjah's industrial areas have many computer traders. Posh Laptop's showroom is at Shop 01, Warehouse 02, Madinat Al Salam Warehouses, Industrial Area 5 (behind ENOC 1127), Sharjah, where every renewed laptop is tested and sold with a warranty.

Are laptops cheaper in Sharjah than in Dubai?

Used and renewed business laptops are often cheaper from Sharjah traders than from Dubai malls, but compare the testing, warranty and return terms as well as the price.

Do I need to visit the showroom to buy?

No. You can order online and we deliver across the UAE, usually in 1 to 2 days. You are also welcome to visit and test laptops in person.

Can I upgrade RAM or SSD when I buy?

Yes. Many business laptops can be upgraded, and our technicians can fit more RAM or a larger SSD before you collect or before delivery.
